## Appearance

Diana Barry is a very pretty girl with a lively, merry expression. She features bright, jet-black glossy hair and curls, paired with matching black eyes and vibrant crimson cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Personality

Diana is a ladylike girl who possesses a merry expression and a practical nature. She has a notable taste in dressing and is skilled at making splendid lettuce salad. Additionally, her heart is set on taking music lessons.

## History

When Diana Barry was born, she was named by a schoolmaster who was boarding with her family. Years later, she met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), and the two quickly became bosom friends. Although Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily forbade Diana from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a series of misunderstandings, their friendship was restored when Diana sought Anne's help to nurse her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through a severe case of croup. As they grew older, Diana actively participated in local activities alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), joining the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) to canvass the neighborhood for community funds and attempting to persuade a neighbor against placing medicine advertisements on his fences. During a picnic celebrating Anne's adopted birthday, Diana shared the poignant story of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) while exploring a forgotten garden. She accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on various local adventures, including an ill-fated trip to buy a replacement platter at the Copp farm, helping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) borrow food when an author unexpectedly visited, and getting lost in the woods, which led them to meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepared to leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Diana expressed anxieties about being left behind, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassured her of their enduring bond. Shortly thereafter, Diana became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happened to spot them embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) hit it off upon meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and immediately vow to be lifelong bosom friends. They walk to school together, participate in social gatherings like Diana's party, and remain close companions. Their bond proves strong when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nurses Diana's sister through severe croup, restoring their friendship after a temporary separation forced by Diana's mother.

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Diana meets Charlotta the Fourth when she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) get lost in the woods and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) works as a maid. [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) welcomes Diana warmly as she and Miss Lavendar entertain the girls with tea. Diana later sees her again during visits leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding.
